facts.fact: The MTNDP 2024-2030 lists among the government's CTI-sector milestones of the 2019-2023 plan period the 'launch' of the national digital development policy, naming no approving act or body and no date within that period; as_of is the plan's January 2024 date.

systems.owner: Ministry of Planning and Economic Development
systems.tiers: national; includes Technology and Innovation under the Big 5 Game Changers

systems.country_label: digital transformation strategy for tertiary education
systems.owner: Ministry of Technical and Higher Education
systems.tiers: education sector; described as needed, not adopted

note: The policy is named with the verb 'launch' but its scope is not described in this document, so class is left empty; 'announced' follows from launch with no act named. The plan also lists 'Develop and implement Digital Policy' as a planned activity, undated.
